contact.label: avoid
contact.reason: Punching and contact moves risk a blow to the belly.

inversion_extreme.label: avoid
inversion_extreme.reason: Upside-down and extreme bodyweight holds risk a fall and hard straining.

fall_from_height.label: avoid
fall_from_height.reason: Jumping onto or off a box carries a real fall risk as balance changes.

abs_high_load.label: avoid
abs_high_load.reason: This loads the stretched belly wall hard and makes abdominal separation worse; pick a standing or side-lying core move.

prone.label: avoid
prone.reason: Lying on your belly presses on the bump; switch to a seated or standing version.

loaded_jump.label: avoid
loaded_jump.reason: Jumping while holding weight adds a hard landing and a fall risk with load; drop the weight or the jump.

bar_on_belly.label: caution
bar_on_belly.reason: Holding the bar in the crook of your elbows rests it on the bump; switch to a goblet or front squat.

chest_supported.label: caution
chest_supported.reason: Lying face down on an incline bench presses on the bump late in pregnancy; switch to a seated row or a one-arm row braced on a bench.

crunch_situp.label: caution
crunch_situp.reason: Crunches and sit-ups can make the belly dome or cone; stop if you see that and use side-lying or standing core work instead.

plyometric.label: caution
plyometric.reason: Jumping and hopping is fine only if you already did it before pregnancy; drop it if it causes leaking, pelvic pain or wobbling.

olympic.label: caution
olympic.reason: Fast bar-to-chest lifts get close to the belly; keep only if experienced and switch to dumbbell or hang versions as the bump grows.

decline.label: caution
decline.reason: Head-below-hips positions can cause dizziness and reflux; use a flat-to-incline bench instead.

supine.label: caution
supine.reason: Lying flat on your back for a long time can press on a large vein and make you dizzy; use an incline bench and stop if you feel lightheaded.

loaded_twist.label: caution
loaded_twist.reason: Twisting hard under load strains the stretched belly wall; use light anti-rotation work (e.g. band press-out) instead.

heavy_overhead.label: caution
heavy_overhead.reason: Standing overhead pressing tends to arch the low back as the bump grows; sit with back support or use a landmine press.

unstable.label: caution
unstable.reason: Balancing on wobbly surfaces raises fall risk while your balance is changing; do the move on stable ground.

high_strain.label: caution
high_strain.reason: Very heavy, awkward or explosive full-body efforts make breath-holding and strain likely; keep them light or skip.

recommended.label: recommended
recommended.reason: Good choice in pregnancy: stable, supported and easy to scale.

ok.label: ok
ok.reason: Fine in an uncomplicated pregnancy with clearance; use RPE and the talk test, not max effort.

plyometric.label: avoid
plyometric.reason: You weren't lifting regularly before pregnancy, so skip jumping and fast Olympic-style lifts for now.

olympic.label: avoid
olympic.reason: You weren't lifting regularly before pregnancy, so skip jumping and fast Olympic-style lifts for now.
